canonical_project: KIDS (Kommunale Informations- und Datentechnik Soemmerda) central data center
notes: Kommune21 (2022-01) described KIDS as a countywide e-government and IT-infrastructure project whose benefits include moving municipalities into a new central Rechenzentrum and later linking with Schmalkalden-Meiningen and Greiz systems for a municipal Thueringen-Cloud. Status planned (2022 reporting; no 2025-2026 update found); no MW published.
